test_can_set_locale: test the can_set_locale function to verify it returns True for valid locales and False for invalid ones
test_get_locales: test the get_locales function to retrieve available system locales and filter by prefix
test_set_locale: test the set_locale context manager to verify locale changes are applied and restored correctly
test_can_set_locale_no_leak: test that can_set_locale does not leak locale state when returning False for invalid locale tuples
test_encoding_detected: test that pd.options.display.encoding matches the system locale encoding from LC_ALL environment variable
